messages.en:
{07 02 00}Whoa, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}! I haven't
cleaned my place at all!
It's a pigsty!
{07 06 00}I don't want you to see
this mess!{01 00 00 0a 00} Come back
tomorrow,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Ohoo, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}! Ma pole
üldse koristanud!
Siin on nagu seapesa!
{07 06 00}Ma ei taha, et sa seda
segadust näed!{01 00 00 0a 00} Tule homme
tagasi,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 08 00}Gah! This place is such a
mess! {01 00 00 0a 00}I gotta unpack my
pillows so I can sleep!
messages.et:
{07 08 00}Ahh! Siin on nii suur
segadus! {01 00 00 0a 00}Pean padjad lahti
pakkima, et magada saaks!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Hmm?{01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00} Are you{01 00 00 05 00} here to help
me clean up my room?{02 00 00 05 06}
Yep!
Heck, no!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Hmm?{01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00} Kas sa tulid{01 00 00 05 00} mind
tuba koristama aitama?{02 00 00 05 06}
Jap!
Ei mingil juhul!

messages.en:
{07 01 00}I'm cleaning my room right
now! {07 06 00}This is a restricted
area! Cleaning staff only!
messages.et:
{07 01 00}Ma koristan praegu oma
tuba! {07 06 00}See on suletud ala!
Ainult koristajatele!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}I'm sorry!{01 00 00 0a 00} I'm in the middle
of cleaning up my room.

{07 0d 00}It'll be totally clean
by tomorrow, though,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Vabandust!{01 00 00 0a 00} Olen keset
toa koristamist.

{07 0d 00}Homseks on siin aga
täiesti puhas,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Really?{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}I have to clean all
this stuff up{01 00 00 0a 00} by end of day
today!
{07 14 00}But we can talk for as long
as you like tomorrow,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Tõesti?{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Pean kõik selle
kraami{01 00 00 0a 00} tänase päeva lõpuks
ära koristama!
{07 14 00}Aga homme saame rääkida
nii kaua kui tahad,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}.
